description: Hand-calculated 2D rule illustrations, not formal evaluation instances. Coordinates are [row,column]; literal outputs and read counts are checked by two executors.

examples.title: RELABEL: connected, not same-valued everywhere
examples.manual_check: The equal-valued component has three cells and four unique external boundary cells. Only that component is recolored.

examples.title: LAYER: one simultaneous empty boundary
examples.annotation: p=[1,1], s=+1; new cells do not regrow
examples.manual_check: The component has three cells. Its unique external boundary has six cells: four zeros to fill and two 2s to preserve.

examples.title: STENCIL: read beyond the update ball
examples.annotation: a=[1,1], r=1; all sums read old values
examples.manual_check: Sums on support in row order are 4,2,5,8,3; modulo 4 they are 0,2,1,0,3. Five support cells read 22 incidences over 10 unique coordinates.

examples.title: MOVE: front-to-back motion with obstacles
examples.manual_check: Row 0 has two entities and four checks; row 1 one entity and three checks; row 2 one entity and two checks. Row 0 column 1 is both an origin and destination and remains 1 in the final state. Transit cells [1,2] and [2,3] are written and later cleared, so both belong to write support despite beginning and ending at zero. Only the two encountered blockers [0,3] and [1,4] are read-only.
